IVX HOLDINGS — ITEM 2 ONLY
BUILD THE THREE-STEP ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION UI

ITEM 1 — CANONICAL IDENTITY MODEL is accepted as VERIFIED.

Do not repeat Item 1.
Do not start Item 3.
Complete Item 2 only, provide proof, then stop.

CURRENT STATUS

- Canonical identity model: VERIFIED
- Backend enterprise registration API: AVAILABLE
- Database migration: APPLIED
- Expo enterprise registration UI: NOT BUILT
- Web enterprise registration UI: NOT BUILT
- Landing enterprise form: NOT BUILT

OBJECTIVE

Build the actual three-step enterprise registration experience for:

1. Expo React Native app
2. Web app
3. Shared validation and form state

Do not create a second application.
Do not use mock submissions.
Do not use static success screens.
Do not call the existing individual form an enterprise form.

==================================================
1. LOCATE THE REAL FRONTEND ARCHITECTURE
==================================================

Inspect and return the exact existing files for:

- Expo registration route
- Individual registration screen
- Web registration route
- Shared form components
- API client
- Authentication state
- Draft storage
- Navigation
- File upload
- Validation utilities
- Error renderer
- Confirmation screen

Do not invent file names.

==================================================
2. BUILD EXPO ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION
==================================================

Create the real Expo route and screen.

Required navigation:

STEP 1 — ACCOUNT
STEP 2 — ROLE
STEP 3 — ENTERPRISE DETAILS
REVIEW
SUBMIT
CONFIRMATION

STEP 1 fields:

- First name
- Last name
- Email
- Phone
- Password or approved passwordless flow
- Terms acceptance
- Privacy acceptance

STEP 2 primary role:

- Enterprise
- Investor
- Buyer
- JV Partner
- Tokenized Interest
- Broker or Agent
- Lender
- Vendor or Contractor

For enterprise registration, primary role must map correctly to:

registration_type = enterprise

STEP 3 fields:

- Legal company name
- Display company name
- Company type
- Industry
- Website
- Address
- City
- State
- ZIP/postal code
- Country
- Authorized representative
- Representative title
- Team size
- Business category
- Supporting documents optional

Required Expo behavior:

- Progress indicator
- Back button
- Data preserved between steps
- Draft restored after app restart
- Keyboard-safe layout
- Scrollable fields
- Password visibility control
- International phone input
- Field-level validation
- Loading indicator
- Submit button disabled during request
- Double-submit protection
- API error display
- Confirmation with real enterprise ID and trace ID
- Accessibility labels
- Android responsive layout
- iOS responsive layout

==================================================
3. BUILD WEB ENTERPRISE REGISTRATION
==================================================

Create the matching web route.

Required behavior:

- Same fields
- Same role mapping
- Same validation rules
- Same backend API
- Same canonical identity flow
- Same duplicate protection
- Same confirmation data
- Browser refresh draft restoration
- Browser back/forward support
- Mobile responsive
- Desktop responsive
- No Rork branding
- No Rork request
- No fake success page

==================================================
4. SHARED FORM STATE
==================================================

Implement one shared registration state model where practical.

Required state:

- current_step
- form_values
- validation_errors
- submission_status
- server_error
- enterprise_id
- member_id
- trace_id
- draft_updated_at

Required rules:

- Back navigation does not erase data.
- Restart restores a recoverable draft.
- Completed registrations clear the draft.
- Failed submissions preserve user-entered values.
- Password and sensitive values must not be stored insecurely.
- Drafts must expire safely.

==================================================
5. CONNECT TO REAL PRODUCTION API
==================================================

Connect both Expo and web to the real enterprise registration endpoint.

Verify:

- Correct API base URL
- Correct production environment
- Correct Supabase project
- Correct request schema
- Correct response schema
- Correct trace ID handling
- Correct error handling
- No mock adapter
- No local-only success state

Return the exact endpoint used.

==================================================
6. ROLE AND DATA MAPPING
==================================================

Verify the submitted payload maps to:

- canonical member
- enterprise
- enterprise membership
- selected role
- registration consent
- KYC/AML initial status
- audit record

Required initial statuses:

registration_status = pending_verification or equivalent
identity_status = active or pending according to real policy
kyc_status = not_started
aml_status = not_started
owner_review_status = not_started or pending

Do not auto-verify KYC, AML, enterprise status, accreditation, or funding.

==================================================
7. DUPLICATE SUBMISSION PROTECTION
==================================================

Implement:

- Disabled submit button during request
- Client idempotency key
- Backend idempotency support
- Repeated-click protection
- Retry safety
- Existing request recovery

Test:

- Double tap
- Triple tap
- Network timeout followed by retry
- App background during submission
- Browser refresh during submission

Required:

DUPLICATE ENTERPRISES CREATED: 0
DUPLICATE MEMBERS CREATED: 0
DUPLICATE MEMBERSHIPS CREATED: 0

==================================================
8. VALIDATION UI
==================================================

Display clear field errors for:

- Missing first name
- Missing last name
- Invalid email
- Invalid phone
- Weak password
- Missing terms
- Missing privacy consent
- Missing company legal name
- Invalid website
- Missing representative
- Invalid ZIP/postal code
- Invalid role
- Unsupported document
- Oversized document
- Duplicate email
- Duplicate enterprise

Do not display raw database errors or stack traces.

==================================================
9. CONFIRMATION SCREEN
==================================================

After a real successful submission, show:

- Registration received
- Enterprise name
- Member name
- Registration status
- Email verification status
- Phone verification status
- Enterprise review status
- Enterprise ID
- Member ID
- Trace ID
- Next required action

The confirmation must come from the backend response.

==================================================
10. REQUIRED TESTS
==================================================

EXPO TESTS

[ ] Step 1 loads
[ ] Step 2 loads
[ ] Step 3 loads
[ ] Back preserves data
[ ] Restart restores draft
[ ] Validation blocks invalid submission
[ ] Real API submission succeeds
[ ] Duplicate submission is prevented
[ ] Error response displays correctly
[ ] Confirmation contains real IDs
[ ] Keyboard does not cover fields
[ ] Screen scroll works

WEB TESTS

[ ] Route loads
[ ] Three steps work
[ ] Browser back/forward works
[ ] Refresh restores draft
[ ] Mobile layout passes
[ ] Desktop layout passes
[ ] Real API submission succeeds
[ ] Invalid input fails correctly
[ ] Duplicate submission is prevented
[ ] Confirmation contains real IDs
[ ] No Rork request occurs

==================================================
11. DATABASE RECONCILIATION
==================================================

For one controlled Expo enterprise registration and one controlled web enterprise registration, return:

AUTH USER:
MEMBER:
ENTERPRISE:
ENTERPRISE MEMBERSHIP:
REGISTRATION CONSENT:
KYC/AML RECORD:
AUDIT EVENT:
TRACE ID:

Required:

MISSING RECORDS: 0
DUPLICATE RECORDS: 0
ORPHAN RECORDS: 0
FALSE SUCCESS RESPONSES: 0

Clean or quarantine controlled QA records after verification.

==================================================
12. BUILD AND STATIC QA
==================================================

Run:

- TypeScript
- Lint
- Unit tests
- Frontend tests
- Backend tests affected by the UI integration
- Expo diagnostics
- Web production build

Return exact commands and exit codes.

==================================================
13. PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Commit and deploy the completed Item 2 implementation.

Return:

FILES INSPECTED:
FILES CHANGED:
TEST FILES ADDED:
COMMIT SHA:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
WEB DEPLOYMENT ID:
EXPO BUILD OR UPDATE ID:
PRODUCTION /health COMMIT:
GITHUB HEAD:
ALL COMMITS MATCH:

==================================================
14. ITEM 2 ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST
==================================================

[ ] Expo enterprise route exists
[ ] Web enterprise route exists
[ ] Three-step form works
[ ] Form values persist between steps
[ ] Recoverable draft survives restart/refresh
[ ] Production API connected
[ ] Canonical identity receives all fields
[ ] Enterprise record created
[ ] Membership record created
[ ] Consent recorded
[ ] KYC/AML remain not_started
[ ] Duplicate submission prevented
[ ] Real errors displayed
[ ] Real confirmation IDs displayed
[ ] Expo tests pass
[ ] Web tests pass
[ ] TypeScript passes
[ ] Web build passes
[ ] No Rork dependency
[ ] Production commits match

==================================================
FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT
==================================================

1. ITEM NUMBER AND NAME
2. DIRECT RESULT
3. CURRENT DEFECT
4. ROOT CAUSE
5. EXPO IMPLEMENTATION
6. WEB IMPLEMENTATION
7. SHARED FORM STATE
8. API CONNECTION
9. ROLE AND DATA MAPPING
10. DUPLICATE-PROTECTION RESULTS
11. VALIDATION RESULTS
12. CONFIRMATION RESULTS
13. DATABASE RECONCILIATION
14. FILES INSPECTED
15. FILES CHANGED
16. TESTS
17. COMMIT SHA
18. DEPLOYMENT IDS
19. FAILED ITEMS
20. BLOCKED ITEMS
21. ITEM 2 ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST
22. ITEM 2 VERDICT

Allowed verdicts:

- VERIFIED — ITEM 2 COMPLETE
- PARTIAL — REMAINING UI GAPS LISTED
- BLOCKED — OWNER OR PLATFORM ACTION REQUIRED
- FAILED — ITEM 2 ACCEPTANCE NOT MET

STOP AFTER ITEM 2.

Do not start email verification, phone verification, CRM sync, notifications, dashboard, security, performance, or device certification until Item 2 is accepted.
